title: National Disability Insurance Scheme Worker Check (NDISWC)
summary: This page provides information on the NDIS Worker Check (NDISWC), which is a required worker screening clearance for certain workers supporting or delivering services under the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS).
intro: Certain workers delivering supports or services under the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) are required to have a worker screening clearance. In NSW this is called the NDIS Worker Check (NDISWC).
who_can_apply: Workers delivering supports or services under the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS).

more_info.text: Access support through the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS)

faqs.q: How do I apply for an NDIS Worker Check?
faqs.a: You can start your NDIS Worker Check application to cover new applications or renewing an expired check.

faqs.q: What do I need to know before applying for the NDIS Worker Check?
faqs.a: The NDIS Worker Check application guide provides information on what you need to prove your identity and other helpful details.

faqs.q: How can I check the status of my NDIS Worker Check application?
faqs.a: You can check the progress status of your application to get your NDIS Worker Check number and expiry date.

faqs.q: Do I need to update my NDIS Worker Check details?
faqs.a: Yes, as a clearance holder, you must keep your personal and employment information up to date.
